overview.en: AgroLastro (AGL) is the utility token of AgroLastro by Solidity Brasil, an on-chain stablecoin escrow platform for agricultural trade across Portuguese-speaking countries. LayerZero v2 OFT with the same address on 8 EVM chains; 100% of the supply sits in an official Uniswap v4 AGL/USDC pool with liquidity locked forever; bridge ownership renounced. Not affiliated with Apex Gold Ledger.
